content.text: r03. Premise correction: there is no actual nightly database-cleanup job configured anywhere in this repo's cron scheduler. The `internal/scheduler` package (`/bench/repo/internal/scheduler/`) is a standalone scheduler library — nothing in the codebase imports or registers jobs with it outside its own tests and docs (only `example_test.go` and `integration_test.go` reference it, per `grep -rln "internal/scheduler"`). The "2 AM daily" cleanup job (`Schedule: "0 2 * * *"`) that appears in `internal/scheduler/doc.go:15-17`, `internal/scheduler/README.md:33-40`, and `internal/scheduler/example_test.go:97-104` is only illustrative sample/documentation code demonstrating how to use the scheduler API — it is not a real, wired-up database-cleanup job running in this application. So there's no actual answer to "what time is it scheduled" because no such job exists in production code.
